title: I37c's suited mobs x FA
body:
# I37c's suited mobs x Fresh animations
Give your mobs a nice suit, compatible with FA!
## How to use?
Download fresh animations trough this link:

[Click here!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)

And put this pack over FA like this:

![How to use](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9140ff7664445ffeeee6610ab9baf538416ad749.png)

## Version support:
1.20-1.21.11

### Note!! The mobs added in later versions then 1.21.10 dont have a suit yet :(
